Question: The smaller angle between the hands of a clock at \(12{:}25\) p.m. is:
Solution:
The hour hand moves gradually between the hour marks, so its movement during the 25 minutes must be included. The minute hand moves \(360/60=6^\circ\) per minute, placing it \(25\cdot6=150^\circ\) clockwise from 12.

The hour hand moves \(30^\circ\) in 60 minutes, so it is
\[
25\cdot\frac{30}{60}=12.5^\circ
\]
clockwise from 12. The difference is \(150^\circ-12.5^\circ=137.5^\circ\). Since this is less than \(180^\circ\), it is the smaller angle.

Finally, \(0.5^\circ=0.5\cdot60'=30'\), so the answer is \(\boxed{137^\circ30'}\), choice \(\text{B}\).
